import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd
from io import StringIO

data = """sepal_length,sepal_width,petal_length,petal_width,species
5.1,3.5,1.4,0.2,setosa
4.9,3.0,1.4,0.2,setosa
4.7,3.2,1.3,0.2,setosa
4.6,3.1,1.5,0.2,setosa
5.0,3.6,1.4,0.2,setosa"""

df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(12, 10))
fig.suptitle('Iris Dataset - Setosa Species Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# Scatter plot: Sepal Length vs Sepal Width
axes[0, 0].scatter(df['sepal_length'], df['sepal_width'], c='blue', s=100, alpha=0.6, edgecolors='black')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=10)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Sepal Width (cm)', fontsize=10)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Sepal Length vs Sepal Width')
axes[0, 0].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Scatter plot: Petal Length vs Petal Width
axes[0, 1].scatter(df['petal_length'], df['petal_width'], c='green', s=100, alpha=0.6, edgecolors='black')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=10)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Petal Width (cm)', fontsize=10)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Petal Length vs Petal Width')
axes[0, 1].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Box plot of all measurements
measurements = df[['sepal_length', 'sepal_width', 'petal_length', 'petal_width']]
axes[1, 0].boxplot([measurements[col] for col in measurements.columns], 
                    labels=['Sepal\nLength', 'Sepal\nWidth', 'Petal\nLength', 'Petal\nWidth'],
                    patch_artist=True)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Measurement (cm)', fontsize=10)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Distribution of Measurements')
axes[1, 0].grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# Bar plot of mean values
mean_values = measurements.mean()
colors = ['#1f77b4', '#ff7f0e', '#2ca02c', '#d62728']
bars = axes[1, 1].bar(range(len(mean_values)), mean_values, color=colors, alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
axes[1, 1].set_xticks(range(len(mean_values)))
axes[1, 1].set_xticklabels(['Sepal\nLength', 'Sepal\nWidth', 'Petal\nLength', 'Petal\nWidth'])
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Mean Measurement (cm)', fontsize=10)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Mean Values of Features')
axes[1, 1].grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

for i, bar in enumerate(bars):
    height = bar.get_height()
    axes[1, 1].text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height,
                    f'{height:.2f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
